ideas.title: Investigating the Minnesota ICE operation
ideas.description: This story would investigate the circumstances surrounding the Minnesota ICE operation and the shooting of Alex Pretti, including the Trump administration's response to the incident.
ideas.angle: Follow the money and investigate potential wrongdoing
questions: What were the circumstances surrounding the shooting of Alex Pretti?
How has the Trump administration responded to the incident?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing and shed light on the Trump administration's handling of the situation. By following the money and investigating potential corruption, we may be able to uncover a larger scandal.
